request: Investigate the delay on order ORD-1011.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its promised delivery date, fulfillment status, and fulfillment warehouse.
I will check the shipment tracking to confirm current status, ETA, and any carrier-reported delay reasons since the order has shipped and is past the promised date.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1011 is overdue by 2 days. The shipment was dispatched 4 days after the ship-by date, causing it to miss the 2026-03-14 promised delivery; it remains in transit with ETA 2026-03-17.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1011 fulfillment_status SHIPPED; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-14; fulfillment_warehouse_id WH-ATL; ship_by_date 2026-03-09.
get_shipment_status: SHP-5011 (Harbor Express, tracking HBX-12077) status IN_TRANSIT; dispatch_date 2026-03-13; dispatched_late true; dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4.
get_shipment_status: is_overdue true; days_past_promised_date 2; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-14; current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-17; recorded_delay_reason null.
get_shipment_status: last_event_date 2026-03-15 at Richmond, VA; days_since_last_event 1 (tracking is active).
arguments.likely_cause: Warehouse WH-ATL handed the shipment to the carrier on 2026-03-13, which is 4 days after the 2026-03-09 ship-by date, resulting in missing the 2026-03-14 promise.
uncertainties: Whether Harbor Express will deliver by the 2026-03-17 ETA.
Any additional carrier delays that may occur after the latest scan (2026-03-15).

recommended_actions.details: Inform Wide World Importers that delivery is delayed and provide the current ETA of 2026-03-17 (get_shipment_status: current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-17). Explain that the shipment left WH-ATL on 2026-03-13, 4 days after the ship-by date 2026-03-09 (get_shipment_status: dispatched_late true; dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4).

Ask the Atlanta Distribution Center (WH-ATL) to explain why ORD-1011 was dispatched on 2026-03-13, 4 days past the ship-by date 2026-03-09, and to implement corrective steps to avoid late dispatches (get_shipment_status: dispatched_late true; dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4).

Continue monitoring tracking for HBX-12077; tracking is active with a scan on 2026-03-15 and ETA 2026-03-17 (get_shipment_status). If the ETA slips or no new scan occurs by end of day, be prepared to contact the carrier.

arguments.recommendation: Notify the customer of the 2-day delay and 2026-03-17 ETA, escalate the late dispatch to WH-ATL, and continue to monitor the in-transit shipment.
